title: AgentCraft — Side Panel
author: AgentCraft Docs
summary: AgentCraft's Side Panel is the primary per-agent interface: Chat/Git/Files tabs + a vitals header with model selector, color-coded context bar (green<70%, yellow 70-90%, red>90%), current activity, and last-mission summary. Inline tool-use and thinking blocks; WebSocket streaming; operation ticker; scroll management with 'new content' badge; @-file autocomplete + Cmd+Enter composer; full-screen plan-mode takeover with markdown + gold-highlighted file paths + feedback textarea; yellow-glow + Y/N permission requests; Git tab (Codex) with status labels 'altered/sealed/newly scribed/destroyed'; handoff/fork citations. Game-like 'heroes / missions / scribed' metaphor. Reference design for per-agent IDEs.
key_takeaways: Three-tab side panel (Chat/Git/Files) as the primary agent IDE; opened by pressing Enter on a selected hero
Agent vitals header with color-coded context bar (green<70%, yellow 70-90%, red>90%) + model selector + current activity + last-mission summary
Tool-use and thinking blocks rendered inline; WebSocket streaming with an operation ticker showing fine-grained activity
Full-screen Plan Review when an agent enters plan mode (markdown, gold-highlighted file paths, section nav, feedback textarea)
Yellow-glow + Y/N hotkey permission requests instead of modal dialogs
relevance_notes: AgentCraft is an adjacent agent-authoring product. Its side panel is a directly usable reference design for the cmux + orchestrator dashboard: vitals header, color-coded context bar, inline tool-use/thinking blocks, plan-mode takeover, and low-friction Y/N permission gating are all primitives we want. The game-like 'heroes/missions' metaphor is distinctive but lower priority than the UX mechanics.
